name: mailmux
description: Your mailboxes as MCP tools — read, search, draft and send from mailmux.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the mailmux app running on this machine. Claude can then read and search mail across every connected mailbox, write drafts, and — only when you ask — send. It also gets the chat tools that let it hold a conversation inside the mailmux window.

Nothing to configure: the connector finds your local mailmux server and its access token on its own. Install the mailmux app first, from https://github.com/Remedy92/mailmux.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Where mailmux is listening. Leave the default unless you changed MAILMUX_PORT.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Leave empty. The connector reads the token from ~/.mailmux/bearer.token on its own; fill this only for a non-default data directory.

tools.name: chat_await_message
tools.description: Wait for the user in the mailmux window
